newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Ex-Azeri officials sentenced for 1995 coup attempt.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Azeri officials sentenced for 1995 coup attempt.

text.p: A court in Azerbaijan has sentenced two former senior military officials for plotting a 1995 coup attempt, Itar-Tass news agency reported on Wednesday.

Rafik Agayev, the country's former commander of internal forces, was sentenced to 11 years in jail, and ex-deputy defence minister Vakhid Musayev received a 15-year sentence, Tass reported from the Azeri capital Baku.
The men were convicted of treason in plotting to shoot down the plane of Azeri president Heydar Aliyev in the summer of 1995.
Lawyers for the men said they would appeal the judgement to the country's supreme court.
Interfax news agency said 19 others were also sentenced to five to 13 years in jail for their role in the incident.
